plugins.name: deephaven.ui

plugins.description: Display and interact with Deephaven tables using AG Grid.

plugins.description: A pack of additional UI themes for customizing the look of the Deephaven web IDE.
plugins.author: Deephaven

plugins.author: Deephaven

plugins.description: A plugin for using microphone input in Deephaven.

plugins.author: mofojed

plugins.author: mofojed

plugins.description: An experimental plugin that creates and embeds simple Jupyter notebooks within Deephaven.
plugins.author: jnumainville

plugins.name: Pyinstrument
plugins.description: Deephaven plugin for displaying pyinstrument profiling reports.
plugins.author: gzh2003

plugins.description: A deephaven.ui element that renders a live clock in one of seven faces: digital, retro seven-segment, analog, split-flap, binary, nixie tube, or word clock, themed to match the Deephaven UI.
